jwt_revocation.title: Token Revocation
jwt_revocation.description: Revoke JWTs used by business traffic (data plane). The entry is written to the Redis blacklist shared by the gateways, so every node rejects the token within seconds instead of waiting for its own expiry.
jwt_revocation.scope_note: Scope: the whole gateway deployment (shared Redis), not just this instance.
jwt_revocation.redis_note: The gateway and the console must share one Redis; the feature is unavailable without Redis.
jwt_revocation.switch_desc: When off, gateways stop consulting the blacklist and revoked tokens become usable again. The deployment-level switch is gateway.jwt.revocation.enabled.
jwt_revocation.switch_load_failed: Failed to read the switch state
jwt_revocation.jti_placeholder: The jti claim of the token
jwt_revocation.ttl_placeholder: Leave empty to derive it from the token exp
jwt_revocation.revoke_confirm_desc: Every gateway node rejects it within seconds; the holder must obtain a new token.
jwt_revocation.lift_confirm_desc: The token becomes usable again immediately (if it has not expired).
jwt_revocation.input_required: Enter a token or a jti
